verses.ar: أَلَعَلَّ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ لَا تُنَادِي؟ وَٱلْفَهْمَ أَلَا يُعْطِي صَوْتَهُ؟
verses.kjv: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
verses.web: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

verses.ar: عِنْدَ رُؤُوسِ ٱلشَّوَاهِقِ، عِنْدَ ٱلطَّرِيقِ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَسَالِكِ تَقِفُ.
verses.kjv: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
verses.web: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

verses.ar: بِجَانِبِ ٱلْأَبْوَابِ، عِنْدَ ثَغْرِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ، عِنْدَ مَدْخَلِ ٱلْأَبْوَابِ تُصَرِّحُ:
verses.kjv: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
verses.web: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

verses.ar: «لَكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أُنَادِي، وَصَوْتِي إِلَى بَنِي آدَمَ.
verses.kjv: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice [is] to the sons of man.
verses.web: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

verses.ar: أَيُّهَا ٱلْحَمْقَى تَعَلَّمُوا ذَكَاءً، وَيَا جُهَّالُ تَعَلَّمُوا فَهْمًا.
verses.kjv: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
verses.web: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

verses.ar: اِسْمَعُوا فَإِنِّي أَتَكَلَّمُ بِأُمُورٍ شَرِيفَةٍ، وَٱفْتِتَاحُ شَفَتَيَّ ٱسْتِقَامَةٌ.
verses.kjv: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips [shall be] right things.
verses.web: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ حَنَكِي يَلْهَجُ بِٱلصِّدْقِ، وَمَكْرَهَةُ شَفَتَيَّ ٱلْكَذِبُ.
verses.kjv: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness [is] an abomination to my lips.
verses.web: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

verses.ar: كُلُّ كَلِمَاتِ فَمِي بِٱلْحَقِّ. لَيْسَ فِيهَا عِوَجٌ وَلَا ٱلْتِوَاءٌ.
verses.kjv: All the words of my mouth [are] in righteousness; [there is] nothing froward or perverse in them.
verses.web: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

verses.ar: كُلُّهَا وَاضِحَةٌ لَدَى ٱلْفَهِيمِ، وَمُسْتَقِيمَةٌ لَدَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَجِدُونَ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةَ.
verses.kjv: They [are] all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
verses.web: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

verses.ar: خُذُوا تَأْدِيبِي لَا ٱلْفِضَّةَ، وَٱلْمَعْرِفَةَ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ ٱلْمُخْتَارِ.
verses.kjv: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.web: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلَّلآلِئِ، وَكُلُّ ٱلْجَوَاهِرِ لَا تُسَاوِيهَا.
verses.kjv: For wisdom [is] better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
verses.web: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

verses.ar: «أَنَا ٱلْحِكْمَةُ أَسْكُنُ ٱلذَّكَاءَ، وَأَجِدُ مَعْرِفَةَ ٱلتَّدَابِيرِ.
verses.kjv: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
verses.web: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

verses.ar: مَخَافَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ بُغْضُ ٱلشَّرِّ. ٱلْكِبْرِيَاءَ وَٱلتَّعَظُّمَ وَطَرِيقَ ٱلشَّرِّ وَفَمَ ٱلْأَكَاذِيبِ أَبْغَضْتُ.
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD [is] to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

verses.ar: لِي ٱلْمَشُورَةُ وَٱلرَّأْيُ. أَنَا ٱلْفَهْمُ. لِي ٱلْقُدْرَةُ.
verses.kjv: Counsel [is] mine, and sound wisdom: I [am] understanding; I have strength.
verses.web: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

verses.ar: بِي تَمْلِكُ ٱلْمُلُوكُ، وَتَقْضِي ٱلْعُظَمَاءُ عَدْلًا.
verses.kjv: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.web: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

verses.ar: بِي تَتَرَأَّسُ ٱلرُّؤَسَاءُ وَٱلشُّرَفَاءُ، كُلُّ قُضَاةِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: By me princes rule, and nobles, [even] all the judges of the earth.
verses.web: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

verses.ar: أَنَا أُحِبُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَنِي، وَٱلَّذِينَ يُبَكِّرُونَ إِلَيَّ يَجِدُونَنِي.
verses.kjv: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
verses.web: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

verses.ar: عِنْدِي ٱلْغِنَى وَٱلْكَرَامَةُ. قِنْيَةٌ فَاخِرَةٌ وَحَظٌّ.
verses.kjv: Riches and honour [are] with me; [yea], durable riches and righteousness.
verses.web: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

verses.ar: ثَمَرِي خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَمِنَ ٱلْإِبْرِيزِ، وَغَلَّتِي خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلْفِضَّةِ ٱلْمُخْتَارَةِ.
verses.kjv: My fruit [is] better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
verses.web: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

verses.ar: فِي طَرِيقِ ٱلْعَدْلِ أَتَمَشَّى، فِي وَسَطِ سُبُلِ ٱلْحَقِّ،
verses.kjv: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
verses.web: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

verses.ar: فَأُوَرِّثُ مُحِبِّيَّ رِزْقًا وَأَمْلَأُ خَزَائِنَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
verses.web: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

verses.ar: «اَلرَّبُّ قَنَانِي أَوَّلَ طَرِيقِهِ، مِنْ قَبْلِ أَعْمَالِهِ، مُنْذُ ٱلْقِدَمِ.
verses.kjv: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
verses.web: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

verses.ar: مُنْذُ ٱلْأَزَلِ مُسِحْتُ، مُنْذُ ٱلْبَدْءِ، مُنْذُ أَوَائِلِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
verses.web: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

verses.ar: إِذْ لَمْ يَكُنْ غَمْرٌ أُبْدِئْتُ. إِذْ لَمْ تَكُنْ يَنَابِيعُ كَثِيرَةُ ٱلْمِيَاهِ.
verses.kjv: When [there were] no depths, I was brought forth; when [there were] no fountains abounding with water.
verses.web: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

verses.ar: مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَقَرَّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ، قَبْلَ ٱلتِّلَالِ أُبْدِئْتُ.
verses.kjv: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
verses.web: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

verses.ar: إِذْ لَمْ يَكُنْ قَدْ صَنَعَ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدُ وَلَا ٱلْبَرَارِيَّ وَلَا أَوَّلَ أَعْفَارِ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةِ.
verses.kjv: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
verses.web: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

verses.ar: لَمَّا ثَبَّتَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ كُنْتُ هُنَاكَ أَنَا. لَمَّا رَسَمَ دَائِرَةً عَلَى وَجْهِ ٱلْغَمْرِ.
verses.kjv: When he prepared the heavens, I [was] there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
verses.web: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

verses.ar: لَمَّا أَثْبَتَ ٱلسُّحُبَ مِنْ فَوْقُ. لَمَّا تَشَدَّدَتْ يَنَابِيعُ ٱلْغَمْرِ.
verses.kjv: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
verses.web: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

verses.ar: لَمَّا وَضَعَ لِلْبَحْرِ حَدَّهُ فَلَا تَتَعَدَّى ٱلْمِيَاهُ تُخْمَهُ، لَمَّا رَسَمَ أُسُسَ ٱلْأَرْضِ،
verses.kjv: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
verses.web: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

verses.ar: كُنْتُ عِنْدَهُ صَانِعًا، وَكُنْتُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ لَذَّتَهُ، فَرِحَةً دَائِمًا قُدَّامَهُ.
verses.kjv: Then I was by him, [as] one brought up [with him:] and I was daily [his] delight, rejoicing always before him;
verses.web: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

verses.ar: فَرِحَةً فِي مَسْكُونَةِ أَرْضِهِ، وَلَذَّاتِي مَعَ بَنِي آدَمَ.
verses.kjv: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights [were] with the sons of men.
verses.web: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

verses.ar: «فَٱلْآنَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْبَنُونَ ٱسْمَعُوا لِي. فَطُوبَى لِلَّذِينَ يَحْفَظُونَ طُرُقِي.
verses.kjv: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed [are they that] keep my ways.
verses.web: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

verses.ar: ٱسْمَعُوا ٱلتَّعْلِيمَ وَكُونُوا حُكَمَاءَ وَلَا تَرْفُضُوهُ.
verses.kjv: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
verses.web: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

verses.ar: طُوبَى لِلْإِنْسَانِ ٱلَّذِي يَسْمَعُ لِي سَاهِرًا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ عِنْدَ مَصَارِيعِي، حَافِظًا قَوَائِمَ أَبْوَابِي.
verses.kjv: Blessed [is] the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.web: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مَنْ يَجِدُنِي يَجِدُ ٱلْحَيَاةَ، وَيَنَالُ رِضًى مِنَ ٱلرَّبِّ،
verses.kjv: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
verses.web: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.

verses.ar: وَمَنْ يُخْطِئُ عَنِّي يَضُرُّ نَفْسَهُ. كُلُّ مُبْغِضِيَّ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَوْتَ».
verses.kjv: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
verses.web: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
